_about: PSIP 2026-2027 cost-sharing rules used by the cost calculator. Every number cites the chunk it came from and a short quote that must appear in that chunk (checked by scripts/04_check_data.py). Order of cost sharing, from AET-POL-005: pay the policy year deductible first (unless waived for that service), then the copayment, then coinsurance. Copayments do not count toward the deductible. Without a Student Health referral (when one is required), care is paid at out-of-network cost sharing (AET-POL-010).

deductible.evidence: Student $400 per policy year | $1,500 per policy year

out_of_pocket_max.note: In-network and out-of-network limits are counted separately.
out_of_pocket_max.evidence: Family $3,000 per policy year $8,000 per policy year

referral_rule.rule: No required Student Health referral -> out-of-network cost sharing.
referral_rule.evidence: If you do not get a referral, then we will pay covered services at the out-of-network coverage cost sharing.
exempt: Treatment for an emergency medical condition
More than 25 miles from Student Health
Injury to sound natural teeth or extraction of impacted wisdom teeth
